messages:
alex: Heads-up — telemetry backfills this week exposed late-window pressure. Thinking of a 'hedge window' policy: small grace period per-tenant to accept late events + dynamic quota reallocation from low-usage tenants to ongoing recomputes. Thoughts? :thinking:

marta: +1 interesting. How do you guarantee fairness? we don't want noisy customers to starve others. can we cap per-tenant reallocation?

josh: cost flag — reallocating quotas might spike GPU hours. need an estimator before we enable. can we compute projected token-hours per backfill job?

priya: from observability side we need markers when hedge kicks in, surface in console and telemetry -> `backfill.hedge.start` / `backfill.hedge.end`. also want regression alert if hedged backfills increase error-rate.

sre-bot: incident: recompute-queue spike detected at 2026-03-19T18:12Z — backlog +24% over baseline. Auto-scaling applied.

dan: quick sketch: config might be simple. example:

```yaml
recompute_policy:
  hedge_window: 2h
  per_tenant_cap: 0.15  # fraction of tenant quota
  global_fallback: true
  preempt_threshold_ms: 2500
```

dan: for quota reallocation, propose leaky-bucket style: borrow up to cap, reclaimed after idle_window. prefer low-usage tenants as donors (usage < 30% for 1h).

marta: console question — expose toggle per-customer? or only ops toggle? ops shouldn't babysit every backfill. prefer policy-first: ops config + readonly indicator on tenant page.

alex: agree — policy-first. ops override only in emergencies. also add cost-estimate to console before running backfill: "Projected GPU-hours: X".

josh: I'll prototype a dry-run estimator. need API to query tenant usage and backfill size. propose endpoint: `GET /internal/telemetry/recompute/estimate?tenant_id=...&window=...`

priya: I'll add metrics and dashboards for hedging: hedged_count, avg_delay_ms, donor_tenants list. small console panel preferred.

alex: next steps: josh to prototype estimator + API by EOD Friday, priya to add metric names, dan to open a short RFC with config proto. canary on staging next week? @marta please review UX notes.

marta: ack, will review RFC and mock console indicator.

alex: thanks — linking notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/telemetry-hedge-proposal. I'll open RFC PR and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
